claims.text: Three separate retrievals of NVIDIA's 10 August announcement — from the newsroom, from the investor-relations site, and through a raw-text proxy — return zero occurrences of "residual," zero of "backstop," and zero percentages other than the headline capital figure.
The press release runs to about 760 words of substantive body copy and does not contain the phrase "residual value" once.
